cocLeadership.description: Oversees all staff operations, promotions, disciplinary matters, and overall staff performance.

cocLeadership.description: Assists the Head of Development with development operations, manages larger projects, reviews development work, and assists with maintaining game systems.

cocStaff.description: Handles administrative responsibilities, documentation, records, and organizational support.

cocStaff.description: Maintains order within the community, handles reports, and enforces server rules.

cocStaff.title: Intern
cocStaff.description: Entry level staff member who assists with basic duties while learning FBMR’s systems, policies, and procedures.

rules.title: Respect All Members
rules.body: Treat everyone with respect at all times. Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, or personal attacks will not be tolerated.

rules.title: Follow Discord Terms of Service
rules.body: All members must comply with the Discord Terms of Service and Community Guidelines. Violations will result in immediate action.

rules.title: No NSFW Content
rules.body: Posting or sharing NSFW, explicit, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: No Spamming or Flooding
rules.body: Avoid excessive messaging, repeated content, or unnecessary pinging. Keep chat clean and readable.

rules.title: Use Channels Correctly
rules.body: Stay on topic within designated channels. Misuse of channels disrupts server organization.

rules.title: No Advertising Without Permission
rules.body: Promoting other servers, services, or content without staff approval is not allowed.

rules.title: Respect Staff Authority
rules.body: All staff decisions are final. Do not argue publicly with staff. If you have concerns, handle them professionally through proper channels.

rules.title: No Exploiting or Cheating
rules.body: Abuse of glitches, exploits, or unfair advantages within any affiliated games or systems is prohibited.

rules.title: Keep Usernames & Profiles Appropriate
rules.body: Usernames, profile pictures, and statuses must remain appropriate and not offensive.

rules.title: Do Not Impersonate Staff or Members
rules.body: Impersonation of any member, especially staff, will result in immediate disciplinary action.

rules.title: Follow Chain of Command
rules.body: Use the proper chain of command when reporting issues or requesting assistance. Do not bypass leadership without a valid reason.

rules.title: No Drama or Toxic Behavior
rules.body: Creating unnecessary conflict, stirring drama, or provoking others is not tolerated.

rules.title: Protect Privacy
rules.body: Do not share personal information, yours or others'. Respect everyone's privacy.

rules.title: English in Main Channels (if applicable)
rules.body: Use English in main channels unless otherwise specified to ensure clear communication.

rules.title: Punishments
rules.body: Failure to follow these rules may result in warnings, mutes, kicks, or bans, depending on severity.
